title: delegate the next engineering task to AntiGravity. Integrate …
objective:
delegate the next engineering task to AntiGravity. Integrate VoiceStudio (debpalash/VoiceStudio) into Agentic OS as a first-class optional local real-time STT/TTS provider. Do not replace Jarvis reasoning, LiveKit orchestration, Hermes, or the existing provider abstractions. Integrate VoiceStudio behind the existing speech provider interfaces and preserve Deepgram as a fallback.
The objective is real-time conversational voice. Implement streaming STT and streaming TTS so Jarvis begins speaking the first meaningful phrase while reasoning/tool execution continues. Do not wait for the complete LLM response before beginning TTS.
Required production pipeline:
microphone → streaming STT/interim transcript → semantic endpoint → Jarvis routing → immediate acknowledgment when a tool/perception operation will take time → tool/LLM processing → sentence/phrase streaming TTS → playback while later text is still generating
Integrate VoiceStudio as a local provider, preferably through its OpenAI-compatible local audio API/streaming interface rather than copying its code into AgenticOS. Add provider health detection, reconnect, and automatic fallback to the existing voice provider if VoiceStudio is unavailable.
Fix the current audio truncation defect at the same time. A TTS response is not finished when the last audio chunk is generated; it is finished only after every queued audio frame has actually been played. Track generation-complete separately from playback-complete. Never cut the final word or sentence.
Preserve barge-in: if I start talking, stop current playback immediately without corrupting the next turn.
For slow visual operations such as camera/browser perception, do not leave me waiting silently. Within approximately 500–800 ms after speech endpoint, Jarvis should say a short truthful acknowledgment such as “I’m checking the camera now” or “I’m reading the Comet page now,” then speak the result when perception completes.
Instrument these timestamps for every turn:
speech_end, final_transcript, intent_ready, tool_start, first_llm_token, tts_first_chunk, playback_first_audio, playback_complete.
Measure at least 20 production voice turns and report p50/p95 for speech-end-to-first-audio separately from total task completion latency.
Acceptance requirements:
1. Normal conversational response begins audibly in under ~800 ms where no slow external operation is required.
2. Slow browser/camera operations give an immediate spoken acknowledgment instead of silence.
3. Final words are never clipped across 20 consecutive responses.
4. Barge-in works.
5. Jarvis can switch voices without restarting the entire application.
6. The installed AgenticOS production voice path is tested, not only a standalone VoiceStudio demo.
Do not declare success merely because VoiceStudio produces audio. Success means the real installed Jarvis conversation feels continuous and responsive.

Relevant Context:
Requested over the JARVIS live conversation channel.
